name: Rumble
description: A plugin that adds Rumble as a source
author: FUTO

settings.name: RNSC Cookie
settings.description: For some regions it's required to send a cookie named RNSC with the value of the client's IP address. Rumble sets the coockie and redirects to the same page but grayjay's client does not add new cookies. This creates the too many requests error. Below you can choose how to handle this.

settings.name: Set RNSC cookie from client IP
settings.description: Enable this to detect the client IP and set the RNSC cookie (required in some regions). The IP is read from rumble.com (Cloudflare edge), falling back to ipify.org.

settings.name: Advanced
settings.description: These are settings not intended for most users, but may help development or power users.

settings.name: Use impersonated HTTP client (recommended)
settings.description: Routes requests through the curl-impersonate (HttpImp) client so they match the browser fingerprint that solved the Cloudflare captcha. Disable only for debugging - with it off, captcha-protected requests may be re-challenged.

settings.name: Verbose notifications
settings.description: Show toast notifications for plugin trace messages and failed requests (useful for debugging).

settings.name: Browser fingerprint
settings.description: Which browser TLS fingerprint to impersonate. Automatic tries Firefox, then Safari, then Chrome, and remembers the one that works. Chrome is blocked on most VPN and datacenter IPs.
